# Lockfile Format v3 (Default) v1.1.0

The default lockfile format since Owl v1.1.0. Features:

### Format

```md
# LockFile generated by @owl V3.x.x
# Do not edit manually.

[lock]
manifest-sha512 = "<checksum>"

[[package]]
name = "<name>"
version = "<version>"
path = "<path>"
registry = "<registry>"
compiler = "<compiler>"
language = "<language>"

[[package]...

# Optional: exports and needed dependencies
exports = ["sdl3"]
needed = {
    mire@0.0.7 = "~/.owl/libs/mire",
    kioto@2.4.9 = "~/.owl/libs/kioto",
}
```

### Key Features

- **`manifest-sha512`**: SHA-512 checksum of the lockfile for integrity
- **`[[package]]` entries**: One per dependency with:
  - `name`: Package name
  - `version`: Version string
  - `path`: Path to package (or `~/.owl/libs/<name>` default)
  - `registry`: Registry name or `local`
  - `compiler`: Compiler used (e.g., `mire`)
  - `language`: Language version (e.g., `mire avenys v3.24.27`)
- **`exports`**: List of exported modules (e.g., `["sdl3"]`)
- **`needed`**: Map of required transitive dependencies with version ranges

### Lockfile V1 (Legacy)

Simple format with only `manifest-sha256`, no package entries. Supported for reading/upgrading.

### Lockfile V2 (Intermediate)

Uses `manifest-sha256` or `manifest-sha512`, with `[[dep]]` entries containing basic dependency info. Supported for reading/upgrading.

### Version Selection

- Default: V3 (automatic on first build/run)
- Configured via `owl.toml [owl@lock] version` field
- Can be set to "1" for V1 format or "2" for V2 format
- V3 is recommended and default for new projects

### Lockfile Generation

- **Automatic**: On first build/run if no lockfile exists
- **Manual**: `owl generate` or `owl checkup --fix`
- **Version-based**: Different formats based on `owl.toml [owl@lock] version`
- **Default for new projects**: V3 with `lock = 1` in `[cfg]` section

### Configuration `[cfg]` Section

New in v1.1.0, added to owl.toml:

```toml
[project]
name = "myproject"
version = "1.0.0"

[build]
compiler = "mire"

[paths]
sources = "code"

[dependencies]
mire = { path = "~/.owl/libs/mire" }

[tool.owl.auto-deps]
kioto = { path = "~/.owl/libs/kioto" }

[lock]
lock = 1
update@lock = "Build"
```

- `lock = 1` : Enable lockfile verification (default)
- `lock = 0` : Disable lockfile verification
- `update@lock = "Build"` : Always update lockfile on build
- `update@lock = "Changes"` : Only update when owl.toml or loads change
- `update@lock = "Never"` : Never auto-update lockfile
